title.value: Find welcome gift ideas from founder emails for approval

introduction.value: A Zapier agent watches a Gmail inbox, reads a founder's email, researches small gift-box businesses, and returns a gift list and draft for approval.

method.value: In a Reddit comment describing a recent Zapier agent, the builder said it read new-hire survey email replies to learn each person’s interests, hobbies, profile, and background. It then searched the web for small businesses that make gift boxes, picked low-cost items to match what it learned, wrote a custom note tying each item back to the person, and sent the gift list plus draft note to the builder for approval before anything went out.

outcome.value: The comment presents it as a working workflow the builder had made several versions of, but gives no metrics, volumes, or cost figures. It also doesn’t say how reliable the research or item selection was in practice.

notes.value: The human approval step mattered: the agent only sent the proposed gift list and draft note for sign-off before sending gifts.

source_text.body:
Find welcome gift ideas from founder emails for approval
A Zapier agent watches a Gmail inbox, reads a founder's email, researches small gift-box businesses, and returns a gift list and draft for approval.
Done with
ZA
Zapier Agents
What they did
In a Reddit comment describing a recent Zapier agent, the builder said it read new-hire survey email replies to learn each person’s interests, hobbies, profile, and background. It then searched the web for small businesses that make gift boxes, picked low-cost items to match what it learned, wrote a custom note tying each item back to the person, and sent the gift list plus draft note to the builder for approval before anything went out.
How it went
The comment presents it as a working workflow the builder had made several versions of, but gives no metrics, volumes, or cost figures. It also doesn’t say how reliable the research or item selection was in practice.
Worth knowing
The human approval step mattered: the agent only sent the proposed gift list and draft note for sign-off before sending gifts.
Try it yourself
with
Zapier Agents
Copy prompt
Build an agent that triggers when a new email arrives in [Gmail inbox or label] from a [new founder or customer]. It should read the email, research 5 small businesses that sell [gift boxes or welcome gifts] and fit [budget and the recipient's interests from the email], and reply to me with a ranked gift list plus a draft thank-you note. It must never send anything to the recipient itself, so wait for my approval of the list and draft before any message goes out.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/zapier/comments/1hro1gv/anyone_made_ai_agent_with_zapier
